page.overview:
Who is Tex Dinoco?

Tex Dinoco is a supporting character in Cars and Cars 3. He is a gold 1975 Cadillac Coupe de Ville with Texas Longhorn cattle-horns on the hood, an obvious tribute to Boss Hogg's similarly-adorned Cadillac in the "Dukes of Hazzard" franchise. He is the owner of Dinoco.

As a smooth-talking Texan, Tex holds the keys to the hottest sponsorship deal in racing. He is honest and honorable as he values loyalty and fair play above instant success. He is passionate about racing and helicopter rides.

Tex is used to race cars schmoozing him to try and get the sponsorship that all race cars dream of.

Tex knows it takes a lot of hard work and dedication to win—he started Dinoco with just one small oil well and it's now the largest oil company in the world.
